# UpahJe.my

> Plain, sourced answers about technology for Malaysian small businesses, in English and Bahasa Melayu.

This site publishes short, citable articles. Every claim links to a source; every article states when those sources were checked. Prefer the canonical URL of each language version.

## Concept index

- [Compliance](https://upahje.my/en/topics/compliance): What the rules require, what they do not, and what is unpublished. (1 article)
- [Pematuhan](https://upahje.my/ms/topics/compliance): Apa yang dikehendaki peraturan, apa yang tidak, dan apa yang tidak diterbitkan. (1 article)
- [Buying](https://upahje.my/en/topics/buying): What work costs, how to brief it, and how to compare quotes. (9 articles)
- [Pembelian](https://upahje.my/ms/topics/buying): Kos kerja, cara menulis brief, dan cara membandingkan sebut harga. (9 articles)
- [AI and automation](https://upahje.my/en/topics/ai-automation): Agents, models and the loop that runs your request. (7 articles)
- [AI dan automasi](https://upahje.my/ms/topics/ai-automation): Agent, model dan gelung yang menjalankan permintaan anda. (7 articles)
- [Operations and growth](https://upahje.my/en/topics/operations-growth): How the business runs week to week, and where the duplication hides. (3 articles)
- [Operasi dan pertumbuhan](https://upahje.my/ms/topics/operations-growth): Cara perniagaan berjalan setiap minggu, dan di mana pertindihan bersembunyi. (3 articles)
- [Freelance](https://upahje.my/en/topics/freelance): Selling a skill per project, with the listings counted. (1 article)
- [Bebas](https://upahje.my/ms/topics/freelance): Menjual kemahiran setiap projek, dengan kiraan senarai. (1 article)

## English articles

- [CommandCode, OpenCode, DeepSeek: three different things](https://upahje.my/en/articles/commandcode-opencode-deepseek-numbers): One is a paid CLI, one is a free CLI, one is an API. Their published prices, their drift, and one run that shows an exit code of zero is not success.
- [Google Business Profile: the fields that decide visibility](https://upahje.my/en/articles/google-business-profile-fields): Google documents name rules, category rules, hours and what triggers suspension: what an SME should fix first, and the four fields that get restricted.
- [What a leaderboard row actually measures](https://upahje.my/en/articles/leaderboard-row-anatomy): SWE-bench and Terminal-bench score a model inside someone else's harness. The DeepSeek row is the example, and the run behind it has a reliability profile.
- [Where the same data gets typed three times](https://upahje.my/en/articles/same-data-typed-three-times): 97.2% of establishments use computers. The duplication sits between a digitised front office and a manual back office, and e-Invoice forces one record right.
- [What an AI agent can and cannot do for a Malaysian SME](https://upahje.my/en/articles/what-an-ai-agent-can-do): An AI agent runs a loop on its own: reads a task, calls tools, checks, repeats. What that covers unattended, what needs a human, and what none should touch.
- [The e-Invoice threshold is now RM3 million](https://upahje.my/en/articles/what-einvoice-automation-covers): LHDN raised the e-Invoice exemption to RM3 million on 1 September 2026, freeing 1.1 million traders. What is required, what is not, and what is unpublished.
- [Your first automation should not be your worst process](https://upahje.my/en/articles/your-first-automation-wrong-process): Opinion. The process an owner hates most is often the worst to automate first: automating it removes evidence and hides the exceptions that decide the cost.
- [Agent harness, AI harness, agent framework: what they mean](https://upahje.my/en/articles/agent-harness-vs-ai-harness): An agent harness runs the loop: it executes tool calls, holds the transcript, applies permissions. Vendors say agent harness; AI harness is not their term.
- [Agent harnesses ranked: four CLIs installed on one machine](https://upahje.my/en/articles/agent-harnesses-ranked): DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode scored 1-5 on five weighted criteria, using only what each showed us on 19 November 2026.
- [Automation work in Malaysia: the published rates](https://upahje.my/en/articles/automation-rates-malaysia-published): Thirty published prices for automation work from four Malaysian studios, one independent and one freelancer, checked November 2026. Some pages undated.
- [Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok: what differs](https://upahje.my/en/articles/closed-models-differences): Scores settle little here. What you are stuck with is context window, price per token and documented capability, every cell sourced or marked not captured.
- [API or spreadsheet: which fits your volume](https://upahje.my/en/articles/do-you-need-an-api-or-a-spreadsheet): A spreadsheet wins at low volume with one owner; an API wins when two systems must sync. Three cases where a sheet is right, four signals it stopped scaling.
- [Where an API key goes in a harness, and where never](https://upahje.my/en/articles/harness-api-keys): A harness reads your key from an environment variable or its store. What the key authenticates, four places it must never appear, and what to do if it leaks.
- [Agent harnesses: who makes them, what is open](https://upahje.my/en/articles/harness-landscape-open-closed): Grok Bot and Dots are closed hosted products. OpenBot and MausBot are source-available, and only one is open source on its own licence; a licence row for each.
- [How to brief an automation job so you don't pay twice](https://upahje.my/en/articles/how-to-brief-an-automation-job): Five things a freelancer needs before quoting, a reusable brief template, and the acceptance test to agree before work starts, written for a Malaysian SME.
- [Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Kimi: what the licence allows](https://upahje.my/en/articles/open-models-differences): Four open-weight families, five model cards, four licence shapes: MIT on DeepSeek, a custom Qwen licence, Mistral's own. What each permits and its rental cost.
- [Open or closed models: what an SME can run in-house](https://upahje.my/en/articles/open-vs-closed-models-malaysia): An open-weight model can be downloaded and run on hardware you control: cost per month in Malaysia, the volume where it beats per-call pricing, and the skills.
- [What RM100 a month buys you in AI, in Malaysia](https://upahje.my/en/articles/rm100-budget): RM100 buys a seat in a subscription app or a meter of API tokens. The Bank Negara rate of 19 November 2026, three usage levels, and where tokens win.
- [Five side-income skills in Malaysia that pay in 2026](https://upahje.my/en/articles/side-income-skills-malaysia-2026): Five skills clear a two-listing bar on the one Malaysian freelance platform whose public pages could be read, with rates, counts and dates from 11 listings.
- [What an agent harness is, and what it does with your request](https://upahje.my/en/articles/using-the-harness): A harness sits between you and the model: it holds the conversation, runs tools, sends each request and streams the answer. What one message looks like.
- [What is an API, for a Malaysian small business owner](https://upahje.my/en/articles/what-is-an-api-for-malaysian-sme): An API is a contract that lets two systems exchange data without a human copying it. What it means for a Malaysian SME, open versus closed models, and the cost.

## Bahasa Melayu articles

- [Apa yang sebenarnya diukur oleh satu baris papan pendahulu](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/anatomi-baris-papan-pendahulu): SWE-bench dan Terminal-bench menilai model di dalam harness orang lain. Baris DeepSeek contohnya, dan larian di belakangnya ada profil kebolehpercayaan.
- [Apa yang AI agent boleh buat untuk PKS Malaysia](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-yang-agent-boleh-buat): AI agent menjalankan gelung sendiri: baca tugasan, panggil tool, ulang. Apa yang dibuat tanpa penyeliaan, apa yang perlukan manusia, apa yang jangan disentuh.
- [Ambang e-Invoice kini RM3 juta](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-yang-automasi-e-invoice-liputi): LHDN menaikkan pengecualian e-Invoice kepada RM3 juta pada 1 September 2026, melepaskan 1.1 juta peniaga. Apa yang diwajibkan, apa yang tidak.
- [Automasi pertama anda bukan proses yang paling anda benci](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/automasi-pertama-bukan-proses-terburuk): Pendapat. Proses yang paling dibenci pemilik selalunya yang paling buruk untuk diautomasikan: ia membuang bukti dan menyembunyikan pengecualian penentu kos.
- [CommandCode, OpenCode, DeepSeek: tiga nama, tiga jenis benda](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/commandcode-opencode-deepseek-angka): Satu CLI berbayar, satu CLI percuma, satu API. Harga yang diterbitkan, perubahannya, dan satu larian yang menunjukkan kod keluar sifar bukan kejayaan.
- [Di mana data yang sama ditaip tiga kali](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/data-sama-ditaip-tiga-kali): 97.2% pertubuhan guna komputer, jadi penggunaan bukan masalah. Penduaan antara pejabat hadapan digital dan belakang manual, dan e-Invoice memaksa rekod betul.
- [Google Business Profile: medan penentu sama ada anda muncul](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/medan-google-business-profile): Google mendokumenkan peraturan nama, kategori, waktu dan pencetus penggantungan; apa patut PKS betulkan dahulu, dan empat medan yang menghadkan profil.
- [Agent harness, AI harness, agent framework: maksudnya](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/agent-harness-atau-ai-harness): Agent harness menjalankan gelung agent: melaksanakan tool call, menyimpan transkrip, menguatkuasakan kebenaran. Vendor guna agent harness, bukan AI harness.
- [Apa itu agent harness, dan apa yang ia buat](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-itu-agent-harness): Harness berada antara anda dan model: ia menyimpan perbualan, menjalankan tools, menghantar permintaan dan menstrim jawapan. Rupa satu mesej di dalamnya.
- [Apa itu API, untuk pemilik perniagaan kecil Malaysia](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/apa-itu-api-untuk-pks-malaysia): API ialah kontrak antara dua sistem untuk bertukar data tanpa orang menyalinnya. Maksudnya bagi PKS, beza model terbuka dengan tertutup, dan kos menyambungnya.
- [Apa yang RM100 sebulan beli dalam AI, di Malaysia](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/bajet-rm100-ai-malaysia): RM100 beli tempat duduk dalam aplikasi langganan, atau meter token API. Penukaran pada kadar Bank Negara 19 November 2026, tiga tahap guna, bila token menang.
- [Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Kimi: apa lesen benarkan](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/beza-model-terbuka): Empat keluarga, lima kad model, empat bentuk lesen: MIT pada DeepSeek, lesen Qwen tersuai, lesen terbuka Mistral sendiri. Apa yang dibenarkan dan kos sewa.
- [Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini dan Grok: apa yang berbeza](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/beza-model-tertutup): Skor penanda aras tidak memutuskan banyak di sini. Yang terikat: tetingkap konteks, harga token dan keupayaan didokumenkan, setiap sel bersumber atau ditanda.
- [Cara menulis brief kerja automasi](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/cara-tulis-brief-kerja-automasi): Lima perkara yang freelancer perlukan sebelum memberi sebut harga, templat brief boleh guna semula, dan ujian penerimaan dipersetujui sebelum kerja bermula.
- [Harness agent disusun: empat CLI pada satu mesin](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/harness-agent-disusun): DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, Codex CLI dan OpenCode dinilai 1-5 pada lima kriteria, menggunakan hanya apa yang ditunjukkan setiap satu pada 19 November 2026.
- [Kos kerja automasi di Malaysia: harga diterbitkan](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/kos-automasi-malaysia-harga-diterbitkan): 30 harga kerja automasi dari empat studio, satu pengamal bebas dan satu freelancer, disemak November 2026; beberapa halaman tiada tarikh.
- [Di mana kunci API diletakkan, dan di mana tidak](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/kunci-api-dalam-harness): Harness membaca kunci daripada pemboleh ubah persekitaran atau stor kelayakan. Apa yang kunci itu sahkan, empat tempat terlarang, dan langkah jika ia bocor.
- [Harness agent: siapa buat, mana satu sumber terbuka](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/landskap-harness-agent-sumber-terbuka): Grok Bot dan Dots produk tertutup dihoskan. OpenBot dan MausBot sumber tersedia, hanya satu sumber terbuka pada lesen sendiri; setiap baris ada lesen dan bukti.
- [Lima kemahiran sampingan yang bayar pada 2026](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/lima-kemahiran-pendapatan-sampingan-2026): Lima kemahiran melepasi syarat dua senarai pada satu-satunya platform freelance Malaysia yang boleh dibaca, dengan kadar, kiraan dan tarikh daripada 11 senarai.
- [Model terbuka atau tertutup: apa PKS boleh jalankan](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/model-terbuka-atau-tertutup-pks-malaysia): Model terbuka boleh dimuat turun dan dijalankan pada perkakasan sendiri: kos sebulan, jumlah di mana ia kalahkan bayaran ikut panggilan, dan kemahiran.
- [API atau spreadsheet: pilih ikut jumlah](https://upahje.my/ms/articles/perlu-api-atau-cukup-spreadsheet): Spreadsheet menang pada jumlah kecil, satu pemilik; API menang apabila dua sistem harus selaras. Tiga keadaan spreadsheet betul, empat tanda ia tidak memadai.

## Repo directory

- [Video generation](https://upahje.my/en/repos/video-generation): The models and inference stacks you would actually run, not the app wrappers around them. (14 repos, GitHub API 2026-11-23)
- [Penjanaan video](https://upahje.my/ms/repos/video-generation): Model dan tindanan inferens yang benar-benar boleh dijalankan, bukan pembungkus aplikasi di sekelilingnya. (14 repo, API GitHub 2026-11-23)
- [Game development](https://upahje.my/en/repos/game-dev): Engines, frameworks and the asset path underneath them. (18 repos, GitHub API 2026-11-23)
- [Pembangunan permainan](https://upahje.my/ms/repos/game-dev): Enjin, rangka kerja dan laluan aset di bawahnya. (18 repo, API GitHub 2026-11-23)
- [Game studio pipeline](https://upahje.my/en/repos/game-studio): The jobs a studio does every week: art, audio, large files, builds. (14 repos, GitHub API 2026-11-23)
- [Saluran studio permainan](https://upahje.my/ms/repos/game-studio): Kerja yang dibuat studio setiap minggu: seni, audio, fail besar, binaan. (14 repo, API GitHub 2026-11-23)

## Library

- [Repos, SDKs and price pages](https://upahje.my/en/resources): every repository and price page the articles cite, with its licence and whether we ran it, read it, or only installed it.
- [Repo, SDK dan halaman harga](https://upahje.my/ms/resources): setiap repo dan halaman harga yang dipetik, dengan lesennya dan sama ada kami menjalankannya, membacanya, atau hanya memasangnya.

## Notes

- Each article lists its sources and the date they were checked.
- Draft articles are not published and are not listed here.
- English and Malay versions are separate, human-written pages linked by hreflang.
